This repository contains the open-source uptime monitor and status page for [Pergolas Valencia](https://pergolas-valencia.com/), powered by [Upptime](https://github.com/upptime/upptime).

[![Uptime CI](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/workflows/Uptime%20CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/actions?query=workflow%3A%22Uptime+CI%22)

[![Summary CI](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/workflows/Summary%20CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/actions?query=workflow%3A%22Summary+CI%22)

With [Upptime](https://upptime.js.org), you can get your own unlimited and free uptime monitor and status page, powered entirely by a GitHub repository. We use [Issues](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/issues) as incident reports, [Actions](https://github.com/pmo-2025/status-pmo/actions) as uptime monitors, and [Pages](https://demo.upptime.js.org) for the status page.
